kind: ACTION
description: Navigate toward the latest pose published by perception, replanning when

- navigate_to_object
- approach_object
- reach_detected_object

    - normal
    - fast
  pose_timeout_ms:
    type: int
    required: false
    default: 5000
    description: Fail if the camera has published no pose within this
    min: 1
    max: 60000
    unit: millisecond
  replan_min_interval_ms:
    type: int
    required: false

    description: Never re-send the goal more often than this, so a jittery pose cannot
      thrash Nav2

patterns.title: Scene prior then local visual search
patterns.content:
# Scene prior then local visual search
When semantic scene memory says an object is usually associated with a known region, use that knowledge only as a search prior. Prefer going to the relevant region when a supported location-navigation skill exists, then visually ground the actual object before object-relative navigation or grasping. If location navigation is unavailable, keep the prior as advisory context rather than inventing a capability.

patterns.title: Ground before navigation
patterns.content:
# Ground before navigation
NavigateToObject requires a current perception-grounded target. A relational clue such as "person beside the table" is a visual query, not a known map coordinate.

Before object-relative navigation, establish the exact target with perception and verify it is visible. For moving or human targets, tracking may be refreshed before navigation. Scene/location priors may guide where to search first, but do not themselves prove that a dynamic target is currently there.

Location RAG is independently retrievable by registered ID/alias; Scene RAG is contextual knowledge and search prior, not the sole gateway to locations.

Only allowed_skill_ids may appear in planner TaskPlanIR robot skill fields.
For an exact named destination with an actionable location, use its deterministic navigation_candidate instead of treating the place name as a visual object.
For an unresolved visual target with a high-confidence actionable search_prior, navigate to that search location before local visual search.
